day_shape: 103 items: OFAC designates 10 individuals/entities over MODAFL weapons procurement, CENTCOM says USS George H.W. Bush has redirected 125 commercial vessels enforcing Iran blockade, IRGC claims 6 militants killed in Sistan-Baluchestan, heavy Khamenei prayer-congress messaging cycle, Netanyahu claims Israel warned UK of Iran-sponsored RAF plot.

threads.label: OFAC action on Iran MODAFL procurement
threads.summary: The US Treasury's OFAC sanctioned 10 individuals and entities across multiple jurisdictions for procuring weapons and components for Iran's Ministry of Defense and Armed Forces Logistics. Iran International, citing WSJ, separately reported Iranian weapons and Chinese dual-use components aiding Houthi territorial gains in Yemen.

threads.label: US-Iran diplomatic track and Hormuz enforcement
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Secretary Rubio ordered Iran's UN delegation to leave the US after talks stalled; Japan's foreign minister phoned Araghchi urging de-escalation. CENTCOM said USS George H.W. Bush is enforcing a US blockade against Iran, having redirected 125 commercial vessels as of September 30.

threads.label: Khamenei prayer-congress message cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published its message to the 33rd National Prayer Congress across multiple Telegram posts, framing prayer as a pillar of jihad and struggle. Defa Press and IRIB amplified the message alongside related clerical commentary.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes under ceasefire
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed Hamas company commander Ammar al-Sharafi in Gaza City, Islamic Jihad rocket operative Bilal Samiri in Khan Younis, and Hamas member Mohammad al-Najar — presented posthumously as a journalist — describing all three as violating the ceasefire. The IDF also published dossiers alleging 10 Gaza journalists had terror ties.

threads.label: IRGC Sistan-Baluchestan clash claim
threads.summary: The IRGC Ground Force's Quds Headquarters said six members of a takfiri group were killed in an operation in southeastern Iran, with explosive packages seized. Iran International reported the hours-long clash in Sistan-Baluchestan province.

threads.label: US withdrawal from Iraq messaging
threads.summary: IRIB aired footage described as US forces leaving Iraq; the IRGC issued a statement calling the departure "the dawn of West Asia's liberation." Defa Press simultaneously published commentary arguing Iraqi sovereignty remains constrained by dollar-based financial ties to Washington.

threads.label: Netanyahu UK warning and Hezbollah financing
threads.summary: Netanyahu claimed Israel warned Britain of an Iran-sponsored plot before a suspected attempt against an RAF base, per Jerusalem Post. The paper also reported Israeli researchers estimated Hezbollah acquired $157 million in weaponry in 2024, mostly donated by Iran.
